title: Aaron Donald has blunt response to Rams return idea: ‘He stared through their souls’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Donald has blunt response to Rams return idea: ‘He stared through their souls’
sources.description: Aaron Donald may be moving closer to a return to the Los Angeles Rams, but if he comes back, it apparently will not be for anything short of an all-in role.
